assumptions.description: The authorized enrichment template fixes 2000 rows, preserved subject_id/x1/x2, and appended x3. The controller supplies actual parent output as observed input; these are fixed synthetic input values, not real-patient measurements.

Compatibility condition for the extension: parent rows come from the committed initial x1/x2 construction for the same artificial population and definitions. Its admitted marginal moments are unchanged by the final packet. The author does not inspect parent outputs or estimate coefficients from them.

Computational choice: PCG64 uses the externally supplied extension seed for one independent standard normal per fixed row, multiplied by the derived conditional residual SD. The controller supplies a separate extension draw from the parent-generation draw. No seed search, fitted residuals, sample-moment correction, truncation or row rejection.

Implementation choice: deep-copy observed input, preserve its index, row order and every subject_id/x1/x2 cell, and append x3 by position. No old values are recomputed, reordered, rounded or cast in the returned copy.

n_rows.derivation: Task-defined output count, not source sample size.

preserved_columns.derivation: Native identifier and initial variable columns retain their definitions, units, order and values.

conditioning_variables.derivation: Condition on both existing generic variables; the final joint Gaussian model gives their exact conditional distribution with x3.

units.derivation: Reported arbitrary units retained without conversion.

distribution.derivation: A conditional of the explicitly reported joint Gaussian is Gaussian; this is derived from the reported family, not an extra normality assumption.

conditioning_mean.derivation: Reported means (12,-7); center fixed x1/x2 at population means, never at realized parent sample means.

outcome_mean.derivation: Reported unconditional x3 mean 40; used as the centered conditional mean baseline.

conditional_slopes.derivation: Derived with A=[[9,27/4],[27/4,25]], c=(-6,14)^T: beta=A^(-1)c=(-1304/957,296/319)^T. Conditional mean is 40 + beta1*(x1-12) + beta2*(x2+7). Stored floats are nearest Python float conversions of the exact rational coefficients; units are u3/u1 and u3/u2.

conditional_residual_variance.derivation: Derived Schur complement: 64-c^T A^(-1)c=64-6752/319=13664/319 u3^2. Gaussian conditional residual is independent of x1,x2. Residual SD is sqrt(13664/319) u3. This is individual variation, not source-parameter uncertainty.

random_generator.derivation: Explicit PRNG and independent residual sampling choice; seed supplied externally.

source_version.derivation: Use the same admitted final evidence as the full joint construction; no additional evidence is inferred from the synthetic parent table.
